name: Deep Work: Putting It All Together
equipment: A notebook and a distraction-free block of time
instructions: Choose one technique from this program (Pomodoro, time blocking, or GTD capture) and pair it with a real deep work block today.
Protect the block the way you would a meeting -- notifications off, door closed if possible, phone out of reach.
Reflect afterward on which technique from the program made starting or staying focused the easiest for you.
Revisit today's opening video as a close to the program -- the goal was never any single technique, but building a repeatable focus practice.
